source: Anthropic public API list prices (platform.claude.com/pricing) as known on 2026-10-14; first-party API rates, standard tier, no batch discount, no fast mode. Model ids are matched exactly, then by the longest '-' delimited prefix (so claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 uses claude-haiku-4-5). Models with no entry, aliases and '<synthetic>' resolve to 'unknown' => null cost and are listed in unpricedModels.
notes: cacheWrite is priced as a 5-minute cache write (1.25x input). 1-hour cache writes cost 2x input but the transcript event carries a single cacheWrite total, so 1h writes are under-counted; summarizeUsage reads an optional cacheWrite1h field when a producer provides it.

cacheRead for claude-fable-5-1, claude-opus-5-5 and claude-sonnet-5-5 are published values ($0.25, $0.20, $0.20). cacheRead for the other models is the standard 10% of input and is inferred, not confirmed.
claude-fable-5 cacheRead is inferred as 10% of input ($1.00); the $0.25 rate was introduced with claude-fable-5-1.
claude-haiku-5-5 prices apply to prompts up to 100K tokens; longer prompts are billed at $0.50 / $2.50 and are not modeled here.
claude-opus-4-1 and claude-opus-4 keep their original $15 / $75 list prices; claude-opus-4-5 and later Opus models are $5 / $25 (claude-opus-5-5: $4 / $20).
claude-haiku-3-5 and claude-sonnet-3-7 are included for old transcripts; their prices are the last ones known and may have changed.
